answers.rationale: Protein and RNA are up, with TCGA RNA and confirmatory protein replicating. RCC holds 95% of transcripts and the purity-adjusted interval is above 0. The protein is surface-annotated, vital staining is level 1 and not enriched. DepMap shows 0 dependent lines, so no selective dependency.

Protein is up and RNA replicates in TCGA. Macrophages hold a larger transcript share (0.6) than RCC (0.2), so the signal is not tumour-intrinsic. Surface call is unknown, IHC was not measured and there is no proteome record. DepMap has 0 dependent lines.

Protein is down, and CPTAC RNA is down with TCGA RNA agreeing, so replicated is yes and the verdict is loss_biomarker. RCC has the largest transcript share and the purity interval is above 0. The protein is internal, liver IHC is level 3, and DepMap shows 0 dependent lines.

Protein is down, and CPTAC RNA is down with TCGA RNA agreeing, so the loss_biomarker rule applies first. CD8_T has a larger transcript share than RCC. The protein is surface-annotated, IHC was not measured and the proteome shows no enrichment. DepMap shows 0 dependent lines.
